settings.title: Ring-Spun Cotton

settings.title: Garment Dye

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subtext: Everything you need to know about NOVA. Can't find your answer?

settings.question: How does garment dyeing affect the fit?
settings.answer: Garment dyeing causes a small, intentional amount of shrinkage and relaxing of the fabric. Our sizing accounts for this — each piece is pre-washed so what you order is what you get.

settings.question: Will the color fade over time?
settings.answer: Yes — intentionally. Garment-dyed pieces develop a beautiful faded patina with wear and washing. Wash cold, inside-out to slow the fade if you prefer.

settings.question: How many pieces can I order?
settings.answer: No limits. Order as many as you want — we batch ship everything in 1–2 business days.

settings.question: How many washes does the garment last?
settings.answer: 100% ring-spun cotton is built for longevity. With proper cold-wash care, these pieces hold their structure and color far beyond fast-fashion alternatives.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery on unworn, unwashed items. Email hello@novaly.us to start a return.
